> 第1章 她该清醒了（第1页）
容辞抵达a国机场时，已经晚点九点多了。
她打开手机时，收到了一堆生日祝福。
刘婶看到她，愣了下：“太太，您……您怎么来了？”
“先生还没回来，小姐在房间里玩呢。”
容辞把行李递给她，上楼时发现女儿穿着小睡衣，正专心的坐在小桌子前，不知在捣鼓什么，非常认真，连有人进房间都没注意到。
封景心听到了，扭过头来开心的叫了一声：“妈妈！”
接着，又转回去捣鼓手上的事情了。
容辞过去把人抱进了怀里，刚亲了下，就被推开了：“妈妈，我还在忙呢。”
容辞已经两个月没见女儿了，很是想念，怎么亲都不够，也很想跟女儿说说话。
见她这么专心，也不想扫她的兴：“心心在做贝壳项链吗？”
“嗯！”说到这里，封景心显然有了兴趣：“还有一个星期就是芜芜阿姨的生日了，这是我和爸爸给芜芜阿姨准备的生日礼物！这些贝壳都是我和爸爸精心用工具打磨过的，是不是很漂亮？”
容辞喉咙一哽，还没来得及说话，又听到女儿背对着她开心的说：“爸爸还给芜芜阿姨定制了其他礼物呢，明天——”
容辞心口一窒，再也没忍住，“心心……记得妈妈的生日吗？”
“啊？什么？”封景心抬头看了她一眼，随即又低头看手上的珠串，抱怨道：“妈妈你别跟我说话，珠子顺序都乱了——”
容辞放开了抱着她的手，没再说话。
她站了很久，见女儿没抬头看她一眼，容辞抿着唇，最后不发一言的离开了房间。
刘婶见到她，说：“太太，刚才我给先生打了电话，先生说他今天晚上有事，让您先休息。”
容辞应了一声，想起女儿刚才的话，顿了下，给封庭深拨了个电话过去。

那边过了好一会才接起电话，声音却很淡：“我还有事，明天再——”
不等容辞说话，封庭深那边就已经挂了电话。
他们夫妻已经两三个月没见过面了，她好不容易过来了a国一趟，他不赶回家里见她一面就算了，就是一封电话，他都没耐心跟听她说完……
结婚这么多年了，他对她一直都是这样，冷淡，疏离，不耐烦。
如果是过去，她肯定会再给他打个电话过去，耐心的问他在哪，能不能回来一趟。
今天可能是太累了，她忽然提不起兴致这么做了。
第二天醒来，想了想，还是给封庭深打了个电话过去。
a国这边和国内有十七八个小时的时差，在a国，今天才是她是生日。
她这次过来a国，除了特别想见女儿和封庭深之外，就是希望他们一家三口，能在这个特殊的日子，好好在一起吃个饭。

Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Latest chapter_Chapter 1 She should wake up. Page 1_Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Yun Zhongmi_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 1 It’s time for her to wake up (Page 1)
When Rong Ci arrived at the airport in country A, it was already past nine o'clock.
When she opened her phone, she received a bunch of birthday wishes.
Aunt Liu saw her and was stunned for a moment: "Madam, you...why are you here?"
"The gentleman hasn't come back yet, and the lady is playing in the room."
Rong Ci handed her the luggage. When he went upstairs, he found his daughter wearing pajamas and sitting at the small table attentively, tinkering with something. She was so serious that she didn't even notice anyone entering the room.
Feng Jingxin heard this, turned around and shouted happily: "Mom!"
Then, he went back to messing around with the drummer.
Rong Ci went over and hugged the person into his arms. As soon as he kissed her, he was pushed away: "Mom, I'm still busy."
Rong Ci hasn't seen her daughter for two months. She misses her very much. She can't get enough of her, and she also wants to talk to her daughter.
Seeing how attentive she was, he didn't want to spoil her fun: "Is Xinxin making a shell necklace?"
"Hmm!" At this point, Feng Jingxin was obviously interested: "Aunt Wuwu's birthday is in one week. This is the birthday gift that my father and I prepared for Aunt Wuwu! These shells were carefully polished by my father and me with tools. Aren't they beautiful?"
Rong Ci had a lump in her throat. Before she could speak, she heard her daughter turn her back and say happily: "Dad also customized other gifts for Aunt Wuwu. Tomorrow -"
Rong Ci's heart suffocated and he couldn't hold it back any longer, "Xinxin...do you remember mom's birthday?"
"Ah? What?" Feng Jingxin looked up at her, then looked down at the string of beads in her hand, complaining: "Mom, don't talk to me, the order of the beads is all messed up -"
Rong Ci let go of the hand holding her and said no more.
She stood for a long time, and when her daughter didn't raise her head to look at her, Rong Ci pursed her lips and finally left the room without saying a word.
When Aunt Liu saw her, she said, "Madam, I called my husband just now. He said he was busy tonight and asked you to rest first."
Rong Ci responded, remembering what his daughter had just said, he paused and called Feng Tingshen.
It took a while before the other party picked up the phone, but his voice was very calm: "I still have something to do, I'll call you tomorrow -"
Before Rong Ci could speak, Feng Tingshen had already hung up the phone.
They haven't seen each other for two or three months. She finally came to country a. If he didn't rush home to see her, it would be fine. Even if he just called her, he wouldn't have the patience to listen to her...
After so many years of marriage, he has always been like this to her, cold, distant, and impatient.
If it was in the past, she would definitely call him again and patiently ask him where he was and if he could come back.
Maybe she was too tired today, and she suddenly couldn't bring herself to do this.
When I woke up the next day, I thought about it and called Feng Tingshen.
There is a time difference of seventeen or eight hours between country a and the country. In country a, today is her birthday.
When she came to country A this time, besides specifically wanting to see her daughter and Feng Tingshen, she also hoped that their family of three could have a good meal together on this special day.
